title: Warranty Keeper
one_liner: Never lose a receipt or miss a warranty window again.
brief:
People buy appliances, electronics and tools that carry a warranty, then lose the receipt and forget the expiry date. When something breaks, they cannot prove purchase and pay for a repair they were entitled to for free.

The app should let someone photograph a receipt, record what they bought, where, for how much, and when the warranty ends, and then remind them before it lapses. It must work entirely offline with no account required: the value is at the shop counter and in the kitchen drawer, not in the cloud.

Monetize with a one-time unlock rather than a subscription. Free users should be able to track a useful number of items before hitting the paywall.
constraints: Offline-first: no account, no backend required for the core value
The camera and local notifications are the only device capabilities assumed
